digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler outbound comment fit guard
propositions: Epic AC1 requires every consolidated duplicated computation to have exactly one implementation defended by a construct-uniqueness test in the delivery child; the outbound-comment fit consolidation (story 4cee) lacks this guard despite being one of five prior offenders.

A construct-uniqueness guard must scan src/rebar except outbound_comments.py, match the conjunction of fit calls (fit_comment/sanitize_comment/fit_preserving_marker) AND to_wire in the same function scope, and require mandatory reason text in comment-fit-ok escape markers.
An unmarked second fit-then-wire derivation must fail the guard; the same derivation with a reasoned marker must pass; the same derivation with a bare reasonless marker must fail again.
